issue.title: Bob Mac Capture Control-Return: capture, then land on it in Obsidian
issue.description: In Bob Mac Capture, Control-Return captures the draft, then brings Obsidian forward with every note the capture changed open in its own tab. The caret sits on the exact line that changed, which gets a short highlight. bob decides what to open, so the app stays a thin client. One Obsidian URL carries the whole list, so tabs never replace each other. The panel shows beforehand what Control-Return will open.
issue.creation_reason: Approved epic plan plan:202610/ctrl_enter_capture_and_open.md requests this work

issue.title: bob reports which notes a capture should open
issue.description: bob-open-notes: add the always-present, batch-level `open_notes` array to `bob capture --format json` (dry-run and real runs alike). Each entry carries an absolute path, a role, a label, and a landing line and ref taken from the final staged text. Document the field in docs/capture.md and test every capture kind.

issue.title: Obsidian handler that opens several notes and lands on each
issue.description: obsidian-open-uri: in bob-plugins, register a read-only `obsidian://bob-open-notes` handler in bob-navigation-hotkeys. It runs one URL at a time, waits until bob's writes are visible in Obsidian, opens the notes under the tab policy, and lands on and highlights the primary line. Also covers notices, tests, README, version bump, build, and `bob plugins sync`.

issue.title: Portable open plan and URL builder in CaptureCore
issue.description: mac-open-core: in bob-mac-capture's CaptureCore, decode `open_notes` and add `CaptureOpenPlan`: bob's entries, or a single shared fallback for older bob that replaces the two duplicated heuristics. Add the `bob-open-notes` URL builder and helpers that save the plan into and read it back from notifications, all covered by portable tests.

Landing repairs verified; epic bob-cli-8w closed.

What was verified: all five phases (8w.1–8w.5) against the epic plan and DECISIONS (tab_policy = new_tab, notify_after_open = yes). Control-Return captures, then opens one obsidian://bob-open-notes URL so each changed note lands in its own tab on the captured line.

- §2 bob-plugins: reuse only getViewType()==="empty"; placeDuplicateTabAfterSource for tab order; shared Go To regexes, resolveGoToVaultFile, findLeafShowingPath (first match); bob-navigation-hotkeys 2.44.1.
- §3 bob-mac-capture: template kind guard; pull-in open intent only on a real commit; Return branches strip [.capsLock, .numericPad, .function, .help]; README needs plugin ≥ 2.44.1; noteOpener reports localizedDescription via shared NSWorkspace helper; LossyOpenNote drops only bad entries; legacy day label "Today"; real-bob linked-task fixture.
